projects.name: Affordable Housing Conversion Proposal
projects.summary: A developer is seeking city approval to convert two existing 'luxury' apartment complexes in Milwaukee into affordable housing units, a proposal the city council is poised to reject.

projects.name: New Milwaukee Library
projects.summary: A new library branch is being planned for a key location in Milwaukee to replace an aging existing facility, a project the city has sought for seven years.

projects.name: Versiti Blood Research Institute expansion
projects.summary: The Versiti Blood Research Institute in Milwaukee celebrated a topping-off ceremony for its $79 million facility expansion, marking a significant construction milestone.

projects.name: Fellowship Village
projects.location: 86th and Good Hope Road, Milwaukee, WI
projects.summary: Christian Faith Fellowship Church proposes building Fellowship Village, a 190-unit market-rate luxury apartment complex for young professionals on Milwaukee's far northwest side, a plan currently facing opposition from local residents.
